# Firman Abdul Hakim

> Senior Software Engineer (Backend) dengan 9+ tahun pengalaman. Berbasis di Sukabumi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia.

## Siapa Firman Abdul Hakim?
Firman Abdul Hakim adalah Senior Software Engineer spesialis Backend Engineering: microservices, REST API, dan sistem scalable. Stack: PHP, Node.js (Express, Fastify, NestJS), Python (Flask, FastAPI), Go, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Docker, AWS.

## Pengalaman
- Senior Backend Engineer, PT Logika Sarana Teknologi, Jan 2022 – Apr 2026 (Full Remote)
- Senior Software Engineer (Backend), Jabar Digital Service, Oct 2019 – Dec 2021 (Hybrid)
- Software Engineer, PT LAPI Divusi, Apr 2017 – Sep 2019
- Fullstack Web Developer, PT Munjalindra Karya Indonesia, Nov 2016 – Mar 2017
